posts.title: Choosing the Right Sofa Bed for Your Guest Room
posts.excerpt: A complete guide to selecting the perfect space-saving sofa bed that keeps your guests comfortable.
posts.author: Maple Furniture Team
posts.content:
Selecting the right sofa bed requires balancing seating comfort, sleep quality, and space constraints. In this guide, we dive deep into cushion stiffness, mechanisms (click-clocks, pull-outs), and sizes.

### Form Factor Matters

Measure the room while the sofa is fully extended to ensure smooth guest movements. Solid wood frame construction ensures longevity and prevents wobbling.

posts.title: Caring for Solid Wood Furniture: Care & Maintenance
posts.excerpt: How to dust, oil, and clean your solid oak or walnut furniture so it lasts for decades.
posts.author: Master Craftsman
posts.content:
Dry humidity and direct sunlight are the enemies of high-quality wood. Since our furniture uses genuine Oak and Walnut hardwoods, it is susceptible to expansion under varying humdities.

### Best Cleaning Practices

- Dust weekly with a soft dry microfiber cloth.
- Use a damp cloth for spills, and dry immediately.
- Apply natural beeswax polish twice a year to maintain the rich grain texture.
